choose.h2: How to choose a web design company in Mauritius.

items.h: Ask what the site is for
items.p: A good company asks what you want the site to bring in before it talks about colours. If nobody asks about your customers, the site will look nice and do little.
Most sites fail on the words, not the design. Ask who writes the copy, and whether it is written around the searches your customers make.
A site needs hosting, updates, backups and fixes. Find out who does that after launch, and what it costs each month.
Ask who owns the domain, the content and the accounts. They should be in your business's name.

fl.h2: Your website is where everything lands.
fl.p: People from Google, from your ads and from your social media all end up on your website. In Fledge, every enquiry from your site goes into your CRM and gets a reply in minutes, so nobody who reaches you is lost.

items.q: How much does a website cost in Mauritius?
items.a: It depends on the number of pages, the languages and what the site must do, such as bookings or online sales. After a free growth call, we send a fixed price before any work starts.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: [About 4 weeks from the day we have your content, to confirm.] We agree the dates with you before we start.

items.q: Will my website show up on Google?
items.a: We build every page to be found: the right titles, headings, descriptions and speed, and we connect your site to Google. Where you rank also depends on your competitors and takes time, so we don't promise a position. We show you the searches you appear for, every month.
Yes. We look at what your current site does well, keep what works, and rebuild the rest.

items.q: Can you build an online shop?
items.a: Yes. We build shops that take Mauritian card payments, with your delivery zones, order emails and product pages.
We host and look after your site every month. [We fix any defect found in the first 90 days at no cost, to confirm as our standard.]

items.q: Do you write the content for the website?
items.a: Yes. We write the words for every page, in plain language, around what your customers search for. You review and approve everything before it goes live.

items.q: Can you take over a website another company built?
items.a: Usually, yes. We look at how it was built and where it is hosted, then tell you honestly whether to keep it, fix it or rebuild it.
